items.label: SOFA BED TIPS
items.value: After unpacking, seat cushions recover about 80% in 48 hours and fully regain the shape in about one week. To enhance comfort and improve sleep quality, we recommend placing a blanket or mattress topper on the sofa bed surface in advance

items.label: Elegant Design
items.value: Featuring a unique rolled-arm design, this piece Luxurious and elegant. It adds a distinctive beauty to your space, showcasing your refined taste

items.label: Pull Out Sleeper Sofa
items.value: Easily convert the sofa into a bed by simply pulling it. The Howjoe modular sofa couch comes in dark gray, beige, light gray and black, making it perfect for transforming any room into a functional guest space

items.label: Premium Fabric
items.value: Made with high-quality chenille fabric, offering comfort and breathability. It is wrinkle-resistant, odor-free, and pet-friendly. Durable and easy to maintain, this fabric is ideal for long-term use

items.label: Exceptional Comfort
items.value: Filled with high-density foam and premium spring cushions, our sectional couches for living room offer outstanding bounce-back and comfort. Sitting on it feels like sinking into a cloud, relieving stress and helping you relax

items.label: Space-saving
items.value: Built-in large storage space for blankets, pillows, and more. Keep your items organized and easily accessible while saving space and maintaining a tidy environment

items.label: Built to Last
items.value: The 108 inch modular sleeper sofa supports up to 300 LBS per seat, featuring a solid wood frame and sturdy bolts connectors for reliable support, ensuring long-lasting comfort for every moment you spend relaxing

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: This sectional sleeper sofa bed Comes with a detailed instruction manual and all necessary tools. Two people can easily assemble the couch. If you meet any problems with modular sleeper sofa, we will help you

items: About Accessories：The product is shipped in 4 packages, with a total of 4 independent screw packages, each with spare screws attached. If the packaging of the received product is damaged or missing accessories, we will provide free replacement
